text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I ran in such a big
racing
goal of mine! I've been waiting
almost half a year
for this moment!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm not the same racer I was when I made
my
debut, Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've grown a ton—in fact, you can call me
El
Condor Superfantástica!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It's true that she's improved significantly
since her
last big race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Our major goal to win the Japan Cup in
El Condor
Pasa's classic year starts now.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, my raw strength isn't
the only
thing that's gotten way
stronger!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
There's one more thing that's got
stronger too!
Annnd thaaat's...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You can do it, El! Get 'em!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Bueno, Spe! The support from all my
friends has
more than doubled too!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Over the past six months, my friendships
have
grown tougher than steel and
hotter than
fire—hot enough to set my
heart ablaze!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Elll! We're skipping dinner if you
don't put on
a good race!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Grass! We're not skippin' anything!
Not
dinner or runnin'!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You see, Тренер? When I've got friends
and fans
cheering me on...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Millions might be a bit of an
exaggeration, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
All right, then. Why don't you show me what
you got?

text_block_list.text: Oh? It sounds like you're doubting me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's all right. Prepare to feast your
eyes...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
As I turn into a real condor and cut
straight
through Tokyo Racecourse!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
